title: Weakened at Bernie's, Too
description: Weakened at Bernie's, Too — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to Bernie's Backyard Brawl off Level 1 of MutantMania. Brawl against Vinny Vamoose and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Bernie's Backyard Brawl off Level 1 of MutantMania. Brawl against Vinny Vamoose and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Go to, Ah say go to Bernie's Backyard Brawl and look up Vinny Vamoose. He doesn't always win, but Ah still hear good things about him. Ah want to give him a chance to show me if he's any good. Ah want you to take him on. Fight him, that is. If he ever does something to stand out from the crowd, maybe Ah'll represent him on the professional circuit.

Turn-in:

Hello there, friend. So, tell me about your latest fight, the one with Vinny Vamoose. Uh huh. Uh huh. Uh huh.

Ah see. Well, he sounds like he still has a scrap of promise. Ah'll probably give him another chance. Just one.

Objectives:

  • Brawl with Vinny Vamoose

Client level range: 80–90
